units.title: Lift a polynomial root to force arbitrarily many divisors
units.statement: Because 2023 is divisible by 7 and the derivative of a²+a+2023 at a=0 is 1 modulo 7, the root a=0 modulo 7 lifts uniquely to a root modulo every 7^k. Taking a positive representative makes a²+a+2023 divisible by 7^k and hence gives at least k+1 distinct divisors 1,7,...,7^k.
steps: If a is a root modulo 7^j, choose the next base-7 digit to solve a linear congruence
Use the powers of 7 as explicitly distinct divisors
